reviewedBy: Automated code audit (July 2026). Authored by the agent that made the change — countersign before relying on it.
reason: Repairs to broken JavaScript. No tax band, relief, threshold, statutory rate or formula was changed on any of the three pages; the arithmetic is byte-identical to what was already there. Before this change none of it ran at all. Each page's inline <script> contained an unescaped </script> inside a template literal that builds a printable payslip document. An HTML parser closes the enclosing script element at the first literal </script> regardless of JS string context, so the block was truncated mid-statement and the browser threw 'SyntaxError: Unexpected end of input'. The calculator, the chart and the share and print handlers never initialised. Escaped as <\/script>, matching the sibling script tag already escaped that way inside the same literal. Two further defects came from a translation pass that renamed identifiers rather than prose: w.imprimer() for the DOM's w.print() (5 call sites across the three pages), navigator.partager() for navigator.share() (3 sites), and AfroTools.shareState.whatsappPartager for whatsappShare, which is the name the shared library actually exports (1 site, Uganda). Separately, fr/sierra-leone/sl-paye.html omits the PDF and email-capture modal its English twin carries, but its script still wrote document.getElementById('hiddenGross').value on the calculate path; that threw and aborted calculate() before any figure was rendered, so the Sierra Leone calculator returned nothing at all. The write is now guarded rather than the untranslated modal being re-added. Verified in Chromium against the local origin: all three pages load with no page errors; Ethiopia returns ETB 14,140 net on ETB 20,000 gross (7% employee pension then the published bands); Sierra Leone returns SLE 3,325,360 net on SLE 5,000,000 gross, where it previously rendered nothing. The remaining console error on each page is 'Chart is not defined', which is the jsdelivr CDN being unreachable from this sandbox, not a page defect. The digests moved because the script text changed, not because any figure did — and per .claude/rules/salary-tax.md no 'Last verified' stamp has been touched, since no Act was re-read.
